organization: Bank Rakyat Indonesia New York Agency
business_need: Modernizing legacy infrastructure to support efficient daily vendor updates, rigorous testing tracking, and streamlined documentation.
users_stakeholders: IT Business Analysts, Project Management Office, banking operations staff, and corporate clients.
adoption_posture: Conservative/risk-averse; requires high reliability and proven vendor solutions before deployment.
capabilities_constraints: Must integrate with existing financial reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and project management software (Jira, Smartsheet). Strict regulatory and data residency constraints.
risk_consequence_context: High consequence. System failure or data corruption during the upgrade threatens regulatory compliance, financial reporting, and daily corporate banking operations.
decision_time_horizon: Evaluating architectural readiness and vendor delivery for the MVP 2 rollout over the next 6 to 12 months.
management_question: Are the predecessor technologies of cloud-native architecture proven enough to support the Core Banking System Upgrade (MVP 2) without risking daily corporate banking operations
additional_context: The PMO requires daily vendor updates, rigorous testing tracking, and documentation using Jira and Smartsheet.
